purpose: Measured facts from building the first vehicle game on Red, one record per phase, so later sessions can see what a big engine feature costs and what it costs to run. Narrative and engine friction: docs/analysis/2026-09-29-great-outdoors-engine-findings.md
machine: Intel N97, 4 cores, dev profile CLI (opt-level 1 engine, opt-level 2 dependencies), idle box

phases.adds: sim::kart: pure step_kart, eight-driver table, kart_bump, slipstream_gain
sim::race: `race` scene block, RaceCourse, RaceState (ordered directional gates, laps, standings, countdown, finish grace)
karts and the race inside MatchSim, checksum, Scene.race
phases.notes: tests/kart_race.rs drives two karts through the real tick with pursuit steering

phases.adds: KartSnap (10 B/kart) and RaceSnap (7 B) on the wire, wire-only flag bits, datagram budget accounting
phases.notes: a match without a race encodes byte for byte as before

phases.adds: Predictor kart mode (apply_local_kart, reconcile_kart, reconcile_snapshot), NetEvent::Snapshot.race, session and bot wiring

cost_of_karts_on_the_server.scenario: red_engine2 perf, 8 players, 2 s windows, best of 3, same scene with and without the race block
cost_of_karts_on_the_server.reading: Kart driving, bumps and race tracking add about 1-2 us per tick for 8 karts (noise level). The network cost is exact: 87 bytes per snapshot (7 header + 8 x 10) at 30 snapshots per second = +2.6 KB/s per client.

prediction_over_loopback.scenario: tests/net_race.rs a_real_client_predicts_its_kart_and_the_server_agrees_with_it: real Server thread, real Bot (network client + predictor), 5 s, kart driving straight after a 1 s countdown
prediction_over_loopback.reading: The one correction is the light going green: the server releases the kart a moment before the client hears about it. A client that extrapolates the start from the server tick would remove it.
prediction_over_loopback.unit_level: net::predict tests: with 6 ticks of lag and reconciliation every 4 ticks, all eight drivers (steering, drifting, hopping, a wall) make ZERO corrections and end bit-identical to the server.

verification_gates_per_phase: scripts/ci.sh fmt clippy tests (+ headless-clippy, benches) all green locally before each commit; the full test stage takes several minutes on the 4-core box
not_measured_yet: wall-clock and tokens per phase (no per-phase timing was recorded during the work)
